blocks.h2: Standards and terms we work with

blocks.lead: Something missing? Ask on the consultation call and we will answer it straight.
items: Can you integrate with an existing EHR?
Yes. We build integrations over HL7 and FHIR interfaces, and SMART on FHIR apps that run inside an existing EHR.
Can you support ONC certification requirements?

Where your product needs it, we build against ONC Health IT certification criteria such as USCDI, FHIR and C-CDA and help you prepare for testing. Certification itself is granted through ONC-authorized bodies.
Do you handle HIPAA compliance for us?
We help you build and test to the HIPAA Security Rule and prepare the documentation. Responsibility for compliance stays with your organization, and we work with your legal and compliance advisers.

items.p: AI features, AI security testing and AI governance.
SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and PCI DSS readiness.
Manual testing with a report your developers and auditors can use.
